messages:
Ravi K: Heads-up — Orchid beta week 3 pulse. Enrollment looks noisy: 5 active, 10 invited-no-activity, 3 pending legal, 2 in 'stalled' (Aequitas, HelioMed). Need a quick triage plan.
OnboardBot: [auto] Beta summary: invited=20 active=5 stalled=2 pending_legal=3 invited_no_activity=10. Link: https://dashboard.redwood.com/beta/orchid/overview
Sofia M: Thanks Ravi. I'll take HelioMed (legal delay) and run contract check w/ finance. Can we set a deadline for legal sign-off?
Lina T: I'll do Aequitas — they reported an SDK error on macOS. Connor, could you help with a short debug session?
Connor W: Yup, 20m debug slot today 4:30pm PT. Share logs here and I'll hop on if needed. Also want to add a quick tracking tag: "beta-onboard-step" to mark progress.
Ravi K: Good. Priority: 1) unblock stalled accounts (Aequitas/HelioMed) 2) convert 10 invited-no-activity -> activation with 15m drop-in clinics 3) capture feedback signals post-activation.
Sofia M: For legal I propose a 5-business-day SLA before escalation to AE. I'll escalate after Day 5 to the assigned AE with a summary.
Lina T: SDK error from Aequitas: ``Error: kv_cache_mismatch at init``. They tried quantized model profile. Posting snippet: ```client.init({model: 'orca-1q', kv_cache: true})```
Connor W: Looks like a mismatch between runtime and model runtime flags. Lina, can you try forcing kv_cache=false in their env and see if it boots?
Lina T: Will test and report back. If that works, we'll schedule a patch and recommend quantization profile B.
Ravi K: Outreach plan for the 10 invited-no-activity: two weekly 30-min "drop-in" clinics (Mon 10am PT, Thu 2pm PT). Lina & Connor can rotate office hours. We'll send a calendar invite template.
OnboardBot: [auto] Tag added: "stalled" -> Aequitas, HelioMed. Assignees: Lina T, Sofia M.
Connor W: Also adding a one-question success ping post-activation: "Did you get your first inference? Y/N" small webhook to events pipeline. I'll queue the webhook.
Sofia M: I'll prep a 2-question post-activation survey: 1) main blocker remaining, 2) estimate of time-to-production. Short link will be pasted here.
Ravi K: I'll draft the escalation note for AE -> include procurement status and legal ticket ID. Add exec-sponsor if Day 5 passes.
Lina T: Update: forcing kv_cache=false booted their node. Will coordinate a quick config patch and schedule a regression test.
Ravi K: Nice. Locking owners: Lina = Aequitas debug + clinic rotation; Sofia = HelioMed legal + day-5 SLA; Connor = webhook + office hours; Ravi = escalation + cohort health report.
Connor W: I'll drop the webhook and office hours invites by EOD.
Sofia M: Sending legal check-in to HelioMed now.
Ravi K: Thanks team. Quick wins then follow-ups — we'll recheck status in 48 hours. :rocket:
